issue: The mission can reasonably request service identities while the exact-match evaluator requires a count. A correct identity list must not be labeled a model factual error solely from this mismatch.
disposition: Finish the fixed campaign without replacement runs. Preserve original automated scores. Use independent blind semantic adjudication of every arm after completion; report the ambiguity and do not claim preregistered factual superiority from a post-hoc endpoint change.
